sn35.3:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotam anattā || || Ghānam anattā || || Jivhā anattā || Kāyo anattā || Mano anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
